status: NEW source-scoped interface bindings, not class card approvals

cards.name: Mechanical Aptitude

sourceCard.name: Mechanical Aptitude
sourceCard.effect: Advantage on checks to understand, repair or disable mechanisms. Requires appropriate access and tools; no automatic control of enemy constructs.

source.originalText: Mechanical Aptitude: Gain advantage on checks to understand, repair, or disable mechanical devices.

cards.authoringDisposition: Accessible actual TI understanding/repair/disable checks; not automatic creation/service/salvage or every INT check. TD-06.

cards.name: Explosive Handling

sourceCard.name: Explosive Handling
sourceCard.effect: Throw a known prepared bomb as Bonus Action instead of Action. Removes ordinary accidental misfire, not Warmachine risk or enemy defenses. Cannot command a device with the same Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Explosive Handling: Throw bombs as a bonus action without risk of misfire.

cards.authoringDisposition: No recipe Trap or EN/Rune pulse qualifies. Same Bonus Action cannot command a companion.

cards.name: Quick Fingers

sourceCard.name: Quick Fingers
sourceCard.effect: Open unlocked latch, operate simple switch or retrieve a carried gadget. Does not activate damaging/healing devices, disarm a trap, reload every weapon or add another Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Quick Fingers: Perform device activation and manipulation actions with increased speed.

cards.authoringDisposition: An actual mundane latch/switch/retrieval can qualify; never damaging/healing activation, trap disarm, Rune arming or ram cycle.

cards.name: Technical Knowledge

sourceCard.name: Technical Knowledge
sourceCard.effect: INT+PB DC 15 identifies its ordinary purpose and operating control. Success reveals one safe use, not secret passwords or magical properties. Failure does not destroy item.

source.originalText: Technical Knowledge: Identify the properties and functions of mechanical or alchemical items on sight.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual visible TI ordinary controls/purpose only; no magical properties, password, ownership or formula. TD-06.

cards.name: Improvised Engineering

sourceCard.name: Improvised Engineering
sourceCard.effect: Produce lockpick, wedge, pulley, clamp or equivalent ordinary implement. No weapons, explosives, currency, rare materials or autonomous effects; collapses afterward without sale value.

source.originalText: Improvised Engineering: Create temporary tools or simple devices from available materials.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual compatible reusable auxiliary during its one-hour life; no permanent source input/body reserve or rare toolkit. TD-15.

cards.name: Deploy Anacite Drone

sourceCard.name: Deploy Anacite Drone
sourceCard.effect: Drone is automatic class engine. Selecting this card instead upgrades deployment to Bonus Action and permits 5 ft free initial placement. No free attacks, repair or extra drone.

source.originalText: Deploy Anacite Drone: Summon a mechanical companion that attacks with ranged bolts (1d6 damage + 25% chance to shock).

cards.authoringDisposition: Automatic class drone and selected deployment upgrade; no crafted companion is granted or receives this deployment upgrade.

cards.name: Tinker Bomb I

sourceCard.name: Tinker Bomb I
sourceCard.activation: Action or Bonus Action with Handling
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius within 30 ft, up to 3 creatures
sourceCard.effect: Bomb recipes are automatic engine. Selecting card increases throw range to 45 ft. Use exact bomb profile, saves, stock and friendly-fire rules; no free bomb creation during combat.

source.originalText: Tinker Bomb I: Create and throw Fire or Cold bombs that deal area effect damage.

cards.authoringDisposition: No recipe charge, element, range or rider inheritance.

cards.name: Field Repair

sourceCard.name: Field Repair
sourceCard.effect: Restore S d8+M HP, up to maximum, to functional damaged machine. Cannot revive destroyed objects, heal organic allies, reset duration or recharge limited uses. If the target is disabled by the Tinker’s protected Dissonance-routing feature, Field Repair also clears that disabled state. It does not reset duration, recharge, ammunition or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Field Repair: Quickly fix a damaged mechanical device or construct.

cards.authoringDisposition: All43 actual positive-HP complete TI machines if damaged or specifically Dissonance-disabled; HP only, never servicing. TD-07/08.

cards.name: Analyze Weakness

sourceCard.name: Analyze Weakness
sourceCard.effect: Identify one visibly demonstrated damage resistance. Your next bomb/device damage against it ignores 2 flat DR, not resistance/immunity. No invented weakness or automatic secret knowledge.

source.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities to specific damage types.

cards.authoringDisposition: The11 traps,18 automata and687 can benefit when the actual visible demonstrated resistance/source timing qualifies; ignores2 flat DR only, not resistance/immunity. No attack created.

cards.name: Jury-rig

sourceCard.name: Jury-rig
sourceCard.effect: Choose+1 first attack roll/turn or+5 ft device movement. One modification per item, no stack. Does not change weapon category, spell function, summon limit or command budget.

source.originalText: Jury-rig: Temporarily modify a device or weapon to perform a different function.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual EN weapon through printed weapon predicate; actual TI attack or existing Speed through TD-09; no new attack/Speed.

cards.name: Enhanced Drone Control

sourceCard.name: Enhanced Drone Control
sourceCard.effect: Gain+1 attack roll and can follow simple move/dodge commands while within 120 ft. Attacks still require your Bonus Action and line of effect; no independent turn.

source.originalText: Enhanced Drone Control: Your Anacite Drone gains improved targeting and responsiveness.

cards.authoringDisposition: Class drone accuracy/range only;686 and ordinary crafted automata receive none.

cards.name: Bomb Specialization

sourceCard.name: Bomb Specialization
sourceCard.effect: Add M damage to one target that failed its initial save. No multiplying by area targets or damage ticks; Glue instead increases its slow by 5 ft maximum 20.

source.originalText: Bomb Specialization: Your explosive devices deal additional damage or have enhanced effects.

cards.authoringDisposition: No crafted trap/ram damage increase.

cards.name: Pet Upgrade Slot

sourceCard.name: Pet Upgrade Slot
sourceCard.effect: Choose one of 9 bounded modules in engine. This automatic unlock is not a selected skill. At 13 use Dual Drone Protocols, still shared command budget.

source.originalText: Pet Upgrade Slot: Modify your drone with an Offensive, Defensive, or Support module (level 5).

cards.authoringDisposition: Nine modules/level5 and13 limits retained; no crafted module sockets.

cards.name: Deployable Expertise

sourceCard.name: Deployable Expertise
sourceCard.effect: Gain M maximum/initial HP and+1 AC. Does not heal existing damage when moved or grant additional slots. Drones excluded unless another card says otherwise.

source.originalText: Deployable Expertise: Your deployed devices have increased durability and effectiveness.

cards.authoringDisposition: No M HP/+1AC or class slot conversion for a persistent crafted output.

cards.name: Remote Detonation

sourceCard.name: Remote Detonation
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: Device within 60 ft, 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures
sourceCard.effect: Destroy your device; DEX save 2 S d6 force, half success. Failed save also no Reactions until end next turn. Cannot trigger Volatile Components/Scrap Reaper or another destruction/copy chain; no resource refund.

source.originalText: Remote Detonation: Detonate your devices remotely for area effect damage or stunning (level 9).

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual owned complete TI body may be sacrificed under exact cost/range/target limits; terminal primary consumption/no chains. TD-14.

cards.name: Deploy Sentry Turret

sourceCard.name: Deploy Sentry Turret
sourceCard.effect: Deploy Sentry engine profile: commanded attack range 25 ft PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. No auto fire, extra Bonus Action or shared budget exception. Durability AC 12+PB HP 2 L before upgrades.

source.originalText: Deploy Sentry Turret: Place an automated turret that fires at enemies (level 6).

cards.authoringDisposition: No crafted recipe is a Sentry or receives its attack/slot/cost profile.

cards.name: Deploy Net Trap

sourceCard.name: Deploy Net Trap
sourceCard.effect: Deploy visible Net Trap. First enemy entry STR save or Restrained, repeat end turn or Action escape against DC. Target Huge+instead speed-10 ft. No damage or continued rearming; ends after one creature escapes.

source.originalText: Deploy Net Trap: Set a trap that roots enemies who trigger it (level 6).

cards.authoringDisposition: No source craft Trap gains restraint, enemy filtering or a class deployment.

cards.name: Overcharge

sourceCard.name: Overcharge
sourceCard.effect: Next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target. One pending overcharge, no stacking, does not command device or grant attack. If device expires first cost lost.

source.originalText: Overcharge: Temporarily boost the effectiveness of one of your devices.

cards.authoringDisposition: Only an existing genuine damaging activation of11 traps/18 automata/687; one added S d6 to one target, no command/shot, same pending-source limits. Other TI bodies get no attack.

cards.name: Recalibrate

sourceCard.name: Recalibrate
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: One drone; one visible enemy 60 ft
sourceCard.effect: Drone's next attack against chosen enemy has advantage. Still needs separate command; no automatic shot, enemy type wide permanent buff or crit conversion.

source.originalText: Recalibrate: Adjust your drone's targeting parameters to focus on a specific enemy type.

cards.authoringDisposition: No crafted automaton or686 inherits the class drone advantage feature.

cards.name: Emergency Protocols

sourceCard.name: Emergency Protocols
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: Drone within 10 ft when attack hits you
sourceCard.effect: Drone intercepts: reduce damage to you by S+M and takes same amount unmitigated. It must be active/conscious. Does not redirect again or trigger retaliation loops.

source.originalText: Emergency Protocols: Your drone automatically intercepts an attack meant for you once per encounter.

cards.authoringDisposition: No crafted-body interception or copied class HP/Reaction.

cards.name: Calibrated Precision

sourceCard.name: Calibrated Precision
sourceCard.effect: Each gains+1 to first attack roll per turn. Does not stack with Target Scanner or another Calibrated Precision; no saves bonus.

source.originalText: Calibrated Precision: Allies within 3 tiles gain +1 to hit.

cards.authoringDisposition: A genuinely eligible crafted creature ally/ram operator can receive printed first-attack bonus as an ally; remains nonstacking with Target Scanner and itself. No autonomous buff emission by crafted gear.

cards.name: Safe Detonation

sourceCard.name: Safe Detonation
sourceCard.effect: Exclude any allies and yourself. Grants Danger Close early; at 15 also ignore half cover for bomb save calculations. Does not make destructive sacrifices automatically safe.

source.originalText: Safe Detonation: Your bombs deal no damage to allies.

cards.authoringDisposition: No ally exclusion for crafted traps, explosive Runes or deliberate sacrifices.

cards.name: Protective Programming

sourceCard.name: Protective Programming
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: Drone adjacent to ally hit by attack
sourceCard.effect: Drone grants ally S+M temporary HP before hit resolves. No heal or reversal of hit; max one protected ally, normal temporary HP nonstacking.

source.originalText: Protective Programming: Your drone prioritizes defending vulnerable allies.

cards.authoringDisposition: Only original class drone emits this paid reaction; a genuinely eligible ally can receive normal temp HP, not a new repair/use reset.

cards.name: Efficient Power Cells

sourceCard.name: Efficient Power Cells
sourceCard.effect: A 3 round device lasts 4 rounds (50%rounded down). Healing pulse count unchanged, no extra ammunition or free commands. Does not extend spell concentration.

source.originalText: Efficient Power Cells: Your devices last 50% longer before needing recharging.

cards.authoringDisposition: No crafted encounter/service/charge or persistent duration extension.

cards.name: Nano-Aegis Drone

sourceCard.name: Nano-Aegis Drone
sourceCard.effect: Replace bolts with support mode. Each Bonus Action command pay 1 RP choose one ally 30 ft to heal S d6+M or grant 2 S+Mtemp HP. Maximum 3 pulses; organic healing explicit exception, no attack during mode.

source.originalText: Nano-Aegis Drone: Replace your combat drone with a healing/shield drone that protects allies.

cards.authoringDisposition: No crafted companion gains bolts, healing mode, three pulses or a source control override.

cards.name: Repair Pulse

sourceCard.name: Repair Pulse
sourceCard.duration: Instant; AC until start next turn
sourceCard.effect: Restore each half its maximum HP rounded down and+1 AC. Functional devices only; no construct resurrection, organic HP, resource or use resets.

source.originalText: Repair Pulse: Heal all drones, turrets, and party deployables for 50% HP and grant +1 AC to nearby allies.

cards.authoringDisposition: Up to3 friendly positive-HP qualified TI devices, printed cost/range/HP/temporary+1AC only; not0HP/service. TD-07.

cards.name: Magnetic Wall

sourceCard.name: Magnetic Wall
sourceCard.effect: AC 12+PB HP 2 L, blocks LOS/movement. Reaction when ranged weapon hit ally within 5 ft of wall reduce its damage by S+M and wall takes reduction amount. Requires line between attack and wall; no automatic all-shot absorption.

source.originalText: Magnetic Wall: Deploy a barrier that pulls ranged attacks into it and provides cover.

cards.authoringDisposition: 687 is no wall; crafted items get no wall interception/slot profile.

cards.name: Restoration Field

sourceCard.name: Restoration Field
sourceCard.cost: 3 RP start; 1 RP maintenance; one slot
sourceCard.effect: Concentration. Initial and paid Bonus Action pulse heals up to 3 living allies/devices S d6 HP. Devices must not be destroyed. Same creature once/round, no extra autonomous healing or longer Efficient Cells.

source.originalText: Restoration Field: Create an area that gradually repairs mechanical devices and heals organic allies.

cards.authoringDisposition: Eligible positive-HP friendly TI machines can receive the actual field pulses; source concentration/payments/max3/once-round remain. No0HP/recharge.

cards.name: Overload Suppression

sourceCard.name: Overload Suppression
sourceCard.effect: CON save or fails its next Reaction and has disadvantage on attacks. On failure by 5 also Stunned, shared hard-denial guard. No automatic permanent deactivation, hacking allegiance or ignoring boss immunity.

source.originalText: Overload Suppression: Temporarily disable enemy mechanical devices or constructs.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual TI creature CON or the named object CON+0 bridge only; timed source denial, no control/permanent shutoff. TD-06.

cards.name: Automated Field Kit

sourceCard.name: Automated Field Kit
sourceCard.effect: Bomb stock cap/refill+1; encounter allowance unchanged. Reduce deployable card recharge by 1 minimum 1, on setting counter only. Never refresh rest uses or trigger repeated counter reductions.

source.originalText: Automated Field Kit: Carry an extra bomb and reduce deployable cooldowns by 1 round.

cards.authoringDisposition: No recipe refill, crafting reduction, service reset or extra trap charge.

cards.name: Enhanced Targeting

sourceCard.name: Enhanced Targeting
sourceCard.effect: Gain+1 to hit. Does not stack with Enhanced Drone Control if profile ever counts both, and does not impose save penalties.

source.originalText: Enhanced Targeting: Your turrets gain +1 to hit.

cards.authoringDisposition: None of43 recipes is a class turret. Existing nonstack with Enhanced Drone Control remains.

cards.name: Efficient Recycling

sourceCard.name: Efficient Recycling
sourceCard.effect: Recover 1 RP spent on deploying it, never more than its actual paid cost. Deliberate sacrifice or copy does not qualify. Consume usable debris; no repeated salvage from same object.

source.originalText: Efficient Recycling: Recover components from destroyed devices to create new ones.

cards.authoringDisposition: Ordinary deployment of all43 crafted items paid0RP; later activation/repair RP and GP price are not deployment credits. TD-13.

cards.name: Technical Mastery

sourceCard.name: Technical Mastery
sourceCard.effect: After damage rolld 10; on 10 you may pay 1 RP to add half its unmodified damage dice total rounded down to one target. No second activation, commands, procs, resources or healing duplication.

source.originalText: Technical Mastery: Your devices have a 10% chance to function twice when activated.

cards.authoringDisposition: 11traps/18automata/687 only within actual own-turn window and the paid d10 gate; after-whole-turn companion attacks do not backdate. No second effect. TD-11.

cards.name: Advanced Turret Bay

sourceCard.name: Advanced Turret Bay
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: Two empty ground spaces within 15 ft
sourceCard.effect: Requires 2 available slots (normally 13); if only one, deploy one for 2 RP. Sniper command attack 90 ft S d6 piercing; Burst command DEX save S d4 piercing to 2 targets within 5 ftat 30 ft. One commanded turret per Bonus Action, not both automatically.

source.originalText: Advanced Turret Bay: Deploy two turrets simultaneously in either Sniper or Burst mode.

cards.authoringDisposition: No crafted Small body becomes two turrets or gains Sniper/Burst shots.

cards.name: Gadget Sync Protocol

sourceCard.name: Gadget Sync Protocol
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: One turret within 60 ft after your bomb throw
sourceCard.effect: Turret makes one ordinary shot at surviving bomb target. Replaces its normal commanded damaging action for that turn; cannot combine with another device attack from Bonus Action. No chains or additional bombs.

source.originalText: Gadget Sync Protocol: When you throw a bomb, one turret may fire instantly at the same target.

cards.authoringDisposition: No43 recipe has the ordinary class turret shot; no crafted trap,automaton,686 or687 eligibility. TD-10.

cards.name: Snap Rebuild

sourceCard.name: Snap Rebuild
sourceCard.effect: Restore half its maximum HP. Uses original slot and original expiry; expired devices ineligible. Does not reset limited uses, modules, Overdrive, destruction triggers or bomb stock.

source.originalText: Snap Rebuild: Once per encounter, instantly redeploy any destroyed turret or pet with 50% HP.

cards.authoringDisposition: NEW named bridge for original nonterminal TI wreck with primaries; halfHP, actual class cost/use, original controller cap/duration/service unchanged. No sacrificed/debris-consumed body. TD-07/14.

cards.name: Reconfiguration

sourceCard.name: Reconfiguration
sourceCard.effect: Change between known nonhealing profiles using same HP fraction, slot, expiry and spent uses. Cannot turn a 1 slot device into two, refill ammo, reset trap, create fresh death trigger or morph drone into free bomb.

source.originalText: Reconfiguration: Transform one deployed device into another type.

cards.authoringDisposition: No TI recipe/size/source conversion, new imprint or refunded uses.

cards.name: Field Fabrication

sourceCard.name: Field Fabrication
sourceCard.effect: Create portable ladder 10 ft, hand tool set, pulley, brace or lockable box. No autonomous damage, explosive, rare material, magic item, permanent structure or cash value. Tool must fit one 5 ft square folded.

source.originalText: Field Fabrication: Create a temporary gadget or tool to address a specific situation.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual temporary ordinary tool can serve a compatible reusable task while present; never permanent ingredient/reserve/source-tier substitute. TD-15.

cards.name: Malfunction Field

sourceCard.name: Malfunction Field
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within 5 ft of your device
sourceCard.effect: First spell attack by one enemy has disadvantage. Multiple devices do not multiply effect; area/spell-saves unchanged. Does not create antimagic zone.

source.originalText: Malfunction Field: Enemies near your devices must roll twice on spell attacks and take the lower result.

cards.authoringDisposition: Genuinely active own TI devices may anchor the single once-per-numbered-round hostile spell-attack disadvantage; no multiplied auras, spell-save penalty or antimagic. Current source distances and perception apply.

cards.name: Volatile Components

sourceCard.name: Volatile Components
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: One device destroyed by enemy; one enemy within 5 ft
sourceCard.effect: Deal S fire to that enemy. Deliberate sacrifices, copied objects, friendly damage and secondary explosions cannot trigger. No other procs/resources from damage.

source.originalText: Volatile Components: Your devices explode when destroyed, damaging nearby enemies.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual enemy destruction of own device may supply first source event per round; actual one enemy within5ft; Sfire only. No friendly/sacrifice/secondary chain. Debris retains only actual remaining matter.

cards.name: Unstable Enhancements

sourceCard.name: Unstable Enhancements
sourceCard.effect: Before throw opt for unstable mix; d4=4 adds S d6 to one failed-save target but bomb cannot exclude allies, including Danger Close. Other roll ordinary bomb. Never double entire damage or secondary riders.

source.originalText: Unstable Enhancements: Your bombs have a 25% chance to deal double damage but may affect allies.

cards.authoringDisposition: No crafted trap or ram explosive-dice conversion.

cards.name: Scrap Salvage

sourceCard.name: Scrap Salvage
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: Empty space within 5 ft of debris
sourceCard.effect: Create one Scrapling AC 12 HP L Speed 20 ft, commanded melee attack PB+INT for 1d6 bludgeoning. Counts as deployable slot/shared command. Consumed debris cannot be salvaged again; cannot spawn its own replacement.

source.originalText: Scrap Salvage: Create temporary minions from destroyed devices.

cards.authoringDisposition: Specific class conversion of one eligible physical debris pool, costs/slot/sharedcommand retained; debris consumed once,no generic magical salvage right. TD-14.

cards.name: Boomcore Drone

sourceCard.name: Boomcore Drone
sourceCard.effect: Commanded bolts add 1d6 fire and on hit STR save or push 5 ft. Still one command and normal attack budget; no free activation attack or unlimited stacking.

source.originalText: Boomcore Drone: Upgrade your drone to use blast bolts that deal damage and knockback.

cards.authoringDisposition: Source commanded bolts only; no crafted melee attack or686 attack creation.

cards.name: Overpressure Bombs

sourceCard.name: Overpressure Bombs
sourceCard.effect: Add on failed initial save STR save or choose push 10 ftor Prone. Also add S damage to one failed-save target. No additional blast or compounded slow; do not stack with Thermobaric push.

source.originalText: Overpressure Bombs: Your bombs gain knockback or prone effects with enhanced elemental damage.

cards.authoringDisposition: No ram/trap push,Prone or bonus damage.

cards.name: Scrap Reaper

sourceCard.name: Scrap Reaper
sourceCard.effect: Create one Scrapling Speed 30, AC 12 HP L; next Bonus Action command moves and detonates within 5 ft one enemy for 2 S d6 fire DEX half. Uses one command budget and ends. No chain from deliberate sacrifice or its own death.

source.originalText: Scrap Reaper: When a turret or drone dies, summon a Scrapling that chases and explodes on enemies.

cards.authoringDisposition: Specific source Reaction/RP/short-rest/temporaryslot conversion; nextcommand replaces existing budget; consume debris,nochain. TD-14.

cards.name: Volatile Injection

sourceCard.name: Volatile Injection
sourceCard.effect: Must have strictly more HP than cost. Its next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target; cannot combine with Overcharge, damage cannot be refunded by same activation. No resources gained from self damage.

source.originalText: Volatile Injection: Temporarily boost a device's power at the cost of stability.

cards.authoringDisposition: 11traps/18automata/687 with strictly moreHP than source M loss, own genuine next damaging activation; no Overcharge combination,no refund/freeattack.

cards.name: Catastrophic Overload

sourceCard.name: Catastrophic Overload
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius about device within 60 ft
sourceCard.effect: All creatures including allies DEX save, 3 S d6 fire plus 3 S d6 force on failure, half success. No critical hit, additional destruction proc, salvage, automatic stun or copied damage. Device ends before blast; no Safety exclusion.

source.originalText: Catastrophic Overload: Sacrifice a device for a massive explosion that damages all nearby creatures.

cards.authoringDisposition: Specific class Action4RP/longrest terminal sacrifice; source all-creature blast/no safety/no secondary returns. TD-14.

cards.name: Mech Overdrive

sourceCard.name: Mech Overdrive
sourceCard.cost: 1 long-rest use plus original deployment cost
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: One of your newly deployed devices
sourceCard.effect: Source-derived level 20 feature: extend device duration only. It still occupies its slot, requires normal commands and payments, and is destructible. Healing devices keep maximum 3 pulses; bombs, spent uses and expended charges never refill. Does not create permanent equipment.

source.originalText: You begin with one deployable slot and gain additional slots as you level up. At level 20, you gain Mech Overdrive, allowing one device to become permanent for the duration of a battle.

cards.authoringDisposition: Persistent recipe bodies gain no extension/service/charge/covenant/refill. TD-16.
